item.title: Chung Dong-young: "Reduction of South Korea-U.S. Drills, Trump's Decision After Deep Consideration... Hope for North Korea-U.S. Dialogue" (정동영 “한미 훈련 축소, 트럼프의 고심 끝 결단…북-미 대화 기대”)
item.description:
Unification Minister Chung Dong-young said on the 19th, "President (Donald) Trump's instruction to reduce South Korea-U.S. joint exercises stems from his deep consideration regarding peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula, and the Ministry of Unification is sympathetic to President Trump's decision." (정동영 통일부 장관은 19일 “(도널드) 트럼프 (미국) 대통령의 한-미 연합훈련 축소 지시는 한반도의 평화와 안정과 관련한 고심에서 나온 것으로서 통일부로서는 트럼프 대통령의 결단에 대해서 공감하는 입장”이라고 말했다.)

Minister Chung made these remarks during a plenary session of the National Assembly's Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee, after the final morning round of questions on pending issues, when he requested and received the floor from Chairman Song Seok-jun, stating, "The common goal of the South Korea-U.S. alliance is peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula." (정 장관은 이날 국회 외교통일위원회 전체회의에서 오전 마지막 현안 질의 뒤 송석준 위원장에게 따로 발언권을 얻어 “한-미 동맹의 공동목표는 한반도의 평화와 안정”이라며 이같이 말했다.)

Regarding President Trump's statement that the reduction of South Korea-U.S. joint exercises is "making the situation much safer," Minister Chung assessed, "That is the key point." He added, "I hope this (the reduction of South Korea-U.S. joint exercises) develops into meaningful North Korea-U.S. dialogue and further expands into improved inter-Korean relations." (정 장관은 한-미 연합훈련 축소가 ‘상황을 훨씬 더 안전하게 만들고 있는 것'이라는 트럼프 대통령의 언급에 대해 “그것이 핵심”이라고 평가했다. 그러면서 “이것(한-미 연합훈련 축소)이 의미 있는 북-미 대화로 전개되고, 그리고 남북관계 개선으로까지 확장되기를 기대하고 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier, at the Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee, Minister Chung analyzed the prospects for resuming North Korea-U.S. dialogue, saying, "The North has repeatedly stated that the core of the hostile policy is South Korea-U.S. joint military exercises," and that President Trump's instruction to significantly reduce South Korea-U.S. joint exercises has created the possibility of resuming North Korea-U.S. dialogue. North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un, at the 9th Workers' Party Congress in February, expressed conditional willingness to improve relations with the U.S., stating, "If the United States respects the current status of our state as stipulated in the constitution of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and withdraws its hostile policy toward the DPRK, we see no reason not to get along well with the United States." (앞서 정 장관은 외통위에서 북-미 대화 재개 전망에 대해 “북은 적대시 정책의 핵심이 한-미 연합군사훈련이라고 여러 차례 반복해왔다”며 트럼프 대통령이 한-미 연합훈련 대폭 축소를 지시함으로써 북-미 대화가 재개될 가능성이 생겼다고 분석했다. 김정은 북한 국무위원장은 지난 2월 제9차 노동당대회에서 대미 정책과 관련해 “만일 미국이 조선민주주의인민공화국 헌법에 명기된 우리 국가의 현 지위를 존중하며 대조선(대북) 적대시 정책을 철회한다면 우리도 미국과 좋게 지내지 못할 이유가 없다”며 조건부 대미 관계 개선 의향을 밝힌 바 있다.)

The Wall Street Journal reported on the 18th (local time) that President Trump, who emphasized his "good relationship" with Chairman Kim and ordered the reduction of South Korea-U.S. drills, is pushing for a direct meeting with Chairman Kim as early as this fall. There is speculation that President Trump may seek a meeting with Chairman Kim during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China, in November. (최근 김 위원장과의 ‘좋은 관계’를 강조하며 한-미 훈련 축소를 지시한 트럼프 대통령은 이르면 올 가을 김 위원장과 직접 만나는 방안을 추진하고 있다고 미국 월스트리트저널이 18일(현지시각) 보도했다. 트럼프 대통령이 오는 11월 중국 선전에서 열리는 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 기간에 김 위원장과의 만남을 추진할 가능성이 거론된다.)

item.title: "Supporting People Power Party While Taking Painkillers" – Chung Jeom-sik Visits Park Geun-hye to Invite Her to Party Workshop (“진통제 드시면서 국힘 지원”…정점식, 박근혜 찾아가 당 연찬회 초청)
item.description:
People Power Party floor leader Chung Jeom-sik paid a visit to former President Park Geun-hye on the 19th to express gratitude for her campaign support in the June 3 local elections and requested her attendance at the party workshop scheduled for later this month. (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 19일 박근혜 전 대통령을 예방해 6·3 지방선거 유세 지원에 감사를 표하고, 이달 말 열릴 당 연찬회 참석을 요청했다.)

The floor leader met with Park for about 30 minutes at her private residence in Dalseong-gun, Daegu. Accompanied on the visit were Chief of Staff to the floor leader Yun Yong-geun and lawmaker Yoo Young-ha. (정 원내대표는 이날 대구 달성군 박 전 대통령 사저에서 30여분간 박 전 대통령을 만났다. 이날 예방에는 윤용근 원내대표 비서실장, 유영하 의원이 동행했다.)

Speaking to reporters right after the visit, Chung said, "I visited former President Park to convey our gratitude for her active support of our party during the local elections and for creating an opportunity to rally the conservative base." According to Chung, Park explained her reason for supporting the campaign by saying, "'I couldn't bear watching conservatism collapse like this,' and that 'I supported with the thought that if I could contribute even a little, our party might revive.'" He added, "She said that the day before visiting the Chungcheong region, she fell and was in severe pain, yet she gave campaign speeches while taking strong painkillers. She told us that as a result, her health has deteriorated considerably." (정 원내대표는 예방 직후 기자들과 만나 “지방선거 과정에서 우리 당을 적극 지원하시고, 보수가 결집하는 계기를 만들어주신 것에 대해 감사의 말씀을 전하기 위해 박 전 대통령을 예방했다”고 말했다. 박 전 대통령은 지방선거에서 유세 지원을 한 이유에 대해 “‘보수가 이렇게 허물어져 가는 것을 견디지 못하겠다’는 일념 하나로, ‘내가 조금이라도 보태면 우리 당이 살아나지 않을까 하는 생각에서 지원했다’고 말씀하셨다”고 정 원내대표는 전했다. 그는 “박 전 대통령께서 충청 지역 방문 하루 전 넘어지셔서 굉장히 고통이 심하셨는데도 강한 진통제를 드시고 지원 유세를 하셨다고 한다”며 “그 여파로 건강이 굉장히 많이 악화했다고 말씀해주셨다”고 덧붙였다.)

Chung said that during the meeting he told Park, "It would be wonderful if you could attend the party's lawmakers' workshop scheduled for the 27th–28th of this month and share wise words on the direction the party should take," and that Park responded, "I will consider it." (정 원내대표는 이 자리에서 “이달 27∼28일 개최되는 우리 당 국회의원 연찬회에 참석하셔서 당이 나아갈 바에 대해 좋은 말씀을 해주시면 좋겠다”고 했고, 박 전 대통령은 “검토해보겠다”고 답했다고 한다.)

Chung went on to say, "Although our party is a minority, if we join forces and give the public the impression that 'this party is the only hope,' we will receive greater support in the upcoming elections," adding that Park repeatedly emphasized party unity. (정 원내대표는 이어 “우리 당이 비록 소수당이지만 같이 힘을 합쳐서 국민들에게 ‘그래도 이 당만이 희망이다’라는 생각을 갖게 한다면 다가올 선거에서 더 많은 선택을 받을 수 있을 것”이라며 박 전 대통령이 당 화합을 거듭 강조했다고 전했다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party on 'Cho Hee-dae controversy': "Should only the president's preferred candidates be nominated?" (국힘, ‘조희대 논란’에 “대통령이 원하는 사람만 제청해야 하나”)
item.description:
Lawmakers from the People Power Party (PPP) on the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee held a press conference at the National Assembly on the afternoon of the 19th, stating regarding the controversy over Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae's nomination of Supreme Court justices: "The core issue is not the delay in nomination or the method of nomination, but that the presidential office intervened in the process of exercising the Chief Justice's constitutionally guaranteed authority to nominate Supreme Court justices." (국회 법제사법위원회 소속 국민의힘 의원들은 19일 오후 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 조희대 대법원장의 대법관 임명제청 논란에 대해 “본질은 임명제청 지연과 제청 방식이 아니라, 대법원장에게 보장된 대법관 임명제청권 행사 과정에 청와대가 개입했다는 것”이라고 말했다.)

Rep. Park Hyoung-soo, the minority party's floor spokesperson on the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, said, "Our Constitution grants the Chief Justice the authority to nominate Supreme Court justices, the National Assembly the authority to consent, and the president the authority to appoint," adding, "If the president decides who he wants in advance and the Chief Justice is expected to nominate only those the president prefers under the pretext of prior coordination, how can that be called the Chief Justice's nomination authority?" (법사위 야당 간사인 박형수 의원은 “우리 헌법은 대법원장에게 대법관 제청권을, 국회에 동의권을, 대통령에게 임명권을 부여하고 있다”며 “대통령이 원하는 사람을 정해놓고, 사전 조율을 구실로 대통령이 원하는 사람만 제청해야 한다면 그게 어떻게 대법원장의 제청권이라고 할 수 있나”고 말했다.)

He continued, "What the public needs to know is what demands the presidential office made to the Supreme Court. It must be revealed in detail whether the presidential office insisted on the nomination of a specific candidate, whether it conveyed any preference or exclusion of specific candidates, and which presidential office officials contacted the Supreme Court," adding, "The person who should come before the National Assembly and provide a sincere explanation is not Chief Justice Cho, but President Lee." (이어 그는 “국민이 알아야 할 것은 청와대가 대법원에 어떤 요구를 했느냐다. 청와대가 특정 후보 제청을 고집한 사실이 없는지, 특정 후보를 선호하거나 배제해달라는 의사를 전한 사실이 없는지, 청와대의 누가 대법원과 접촉했는지 낱낱이 밝혀야 한다”며 “국회에 나와 성실히 소명해야 할 사람은 조 대법원장이 아니라 이 대통령”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier, a motion to summon Chief Justice Cho to appear before the Legislation and Judiciary Committee was passed under the lead of the Democratic Party of Korea. PPP lawmakers voted against it. Committee Chair Seo Young-kyo of the Democratic Party said, "The purpose is to question what happened during the process of nominating Supreme Court candidates, which has been vacant for a long period, and the reasons behind referring the trials of Kim Keon-hee, Han Duck-soo, and Lee Sang-min to the Supreme Court's en banc panel." (앞서, 법사위에서는 조 대법원장 출석 요구 안건이 더불어민주당 주도로 가결됐다. 국민의힘 의원들은 반대표를 던졌다. 민주당 소속 서영교 위원장은 “장기간 공석인 대법관 후보 제청 과정에서 어떤 일이 있었는지와 김건희·한덕수·이상민 재판을 대법원 전원합의체로 회부하게 된 사유 등을 질의하기 위한 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Integration Committee Chair Lee Seok-yeon Formally Recommends President Lee Leave Party... Park Ji-won Says "Nonsense Out of the Blue" (이석연 통합위원장, 이 대통령에 탈당 공식 건의…박지원 “자다가 봉창”)
item.description:
Lee Seok-yeon, chair of the Presidential Advisory Committee on National Integration, formally recommended that President Lee Jae-myung leave his party. (대통령 직속 국민통합위원회의 이석연 위원장이 이재명 대통령에게 탈당을 공식 건의했다.)

Appearing on MBC's "100-minute Debate" on the 18th, Chairman Lee said, "The Democratic Party of Korea's national convention is now over" and "It is time to leave the Democratic Party of Korea." (이 위원장은 18일 문화방송(MBC) ‘100분 토론’에 출연해 “이제 더불어민주당 전당대회도 끝났다”며 “이제 더불어민주당을 탈당하라”고 말했다.)

Chairman Lee explained the reason for his proposal, saying, "The ruling party is competing over who is closest to the president, while the opposition is taking an extreme stance of opposition against the president and the government," and "I am concerned that politics is now dividing sides around the president." (이 위원장은 “여당은 대통령과의 거리가 누가 가깝냐며 경쟁하고 야당은 대통령과 정부를 향해 극단적인 반대 입장에서 각을 세우고 있다”, “지금 대통령을 중심으로 정치가 편을 가르는 것이 아닌지 염려도 든다”며 탈당을 제안한 이유를 설명했다.)

Chairman Lee added, "The president has said whenever he had the chance that he would be 'the president of everyone,' but he must bear the heaviest responsibility for the current chaos in state affairs and the severe division of public opinion," and "If he truly intends to make national unity the top priority of governance and become the president of everyone, I believe he should now step outside the political fence of being the president of a single party." He also said, "Leave the Democratic Party to its new leadership, and return as the president of the people, not the president of the Democratic Party," adding, "He should run state affairs from a nonpartisan standpoint. Now is the right time." (이 위원장은 이어 “대통령은 ‘모두의 대통령’이 되겠다고 기회가 있을 때마다 말했지만, 지금의 국정 난맥과 극심한 국론 분열 현상에 가장 무거운 책임을 느껴야 한다”며 “국민통합을 국정의 제1 목표로 내걸고, 진정으로 모두의 대통령이 되고자 한다면 이제는 한 정당의 대통령이라는 정치적 울타리에서 벗어나셨으면 하는 생각”이라고 덧붙였다. 이 위원장은 또 “민주당은 새 지도부에 맡기고, 대통령은 민주당의 대통령이 아닌 국민의 대통령으로 돌아오라”며 “초당적 입장에서 국정 운영을 해야 한다. 지금이 적기”라고 말했다.)

Criticism from the opposition party called for him to "retract his remarks." Five-term Democratic Party lawmaker Park Ji-won posted on Facebook on the 19th, "This is nonsense out of the blue," and sharply criticized, saying, "Our country is a democratic state, and democracy is party politics and responsible politics. This is not something to say to a president who was elected as a party candidate and has been in office for just over a year." (여당에서는 “발언을 취소하라”는 비판이 나왔다. 5선 박지원 민주당 의원은 19일 페이스북에 “자다가 봉창을 때린다”며 “우리나라는 민주국가이고 민주주의는 정당정치이고 책임정치다. 정당 후보로 당선되셨고 1년 갓 넘은 대통령께 하실 말씀이 아니다”라고 직격했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Jang Dong-hyuk must resign" - "Senior lawmakers should sacrifice first"... Workshop expected to be a 'turning point for the party' (“장동혁 사퇴 말해야”-“중진부터 희생해야”…연찬회 ‘체제 분수령’ 될 듯)
item.description:
As senior lawmakers of the People Power Party hold successive meetings on topics such as the 'party's direction,' calls for Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's resignation are reigniting. Prospects are emerging that the lawmakers' workshop, now about a week away, could serve as a watershed moment for Jang's fate. (국민의힘 중진 의원들이 ‘당 방향성’ 등을 주제로 잇따라 회동하면서 장동혁 대표 사퇴론이 재점화하고 있다. 일주일여 앞으로 다가온 의원 연찬회가 장 대표 거취의 분수령이 될 수 있다는 전망이 나온다.)

In an interview on SBS Radio on the 19th, Rep. Kim Jae-seob of the People Power Party said regarding the senior lawmakers' gatherings, "There has always been a consensus that we cannot head into the general election under the current Jang leadership," adding, "Given the actions Jang is taking (outside the party), I think people are feeling that it's time for us to seriously discuss something." Rep. Cho Kyeong-tae, who has been leading the push for Jang's ouster, also appeared on KBS Radio the same day and said, "Senior lawmakers should muster more courage and, even through a joint statement, be able to say to Representative Jang, 'step down'—shouldn't we at least be able to do that?" (김재섭 국민의힘 의원은 19일 에스비에스(SBS) 라디오 인터뷰에서 중진 모임과 관련해 “장 대표 체제에 대해서 이대로 총선에 못 간다는 컨센서스(합의)는 늘 있었다”며 “장 대표가 (장외로) 나가서 하는 행위들을 보면 이제는 우리가 본격적으로 뭔가 논의해야 될 때가 아닐까 생각하시는 것 같다”고 말했다. 장 대표 퇴진론에 앞장서고 있는 조경태 의원도 이날 한국방송(KBS) 라디오에 출연해 “중진 의원들이 좀 더 용기를 내서 단체로 연명을 해서라도 ‘장 대표에게 내려와라’ 이 정도의 말은 할 수 있어야 하는 게 아니겠나”라고 했다.)

Earlier, third-term lawmakers of the People Power Party held a meeting on the 17th and, after discussing the party's direction, agreed that "we should move forward with Floor Leader Jung Jeom-sik at the center." It is said that concerns were raised at that gathering about Jang's moves, which lean heavily toward hardline supporters. At the meeting of fourth-term lawmakers scheduled for the 20th, discussions are expected to continue on how the party leadership operates and its course following the defeat in the local elections. (앞서 국민의힘 3선 의원들은 지난 17일 모임을 갖고 당 방향성에 대한 논의 끝에 “정점식 원내대표 중심으로 가야 한다”고 뜻을 모은 바 있다. 이 자리에서는 강성 지지층에 치우친 장 대표 행보에 대한 우려가 나왔다고 한다. 20일 열리는 4선 의원 회동에서도 지방선거 패배 뒤 당 지도부 운영 방식과 노선에 대한 논의가 이어질 것으로 보인다.)

Jang sharpened his rhetoric that day, appearing on Pen & Mike TV's YouTube channel and saying, "Senior lawmakers must make sacrifices." Referring to senior lawmakers who recently played golf with President Lee Jae-myung, he fired back, "At a time when we should be fighting the Democratic Party tooth and nail, these people are playing golf with a president who dreams of extending his term through constitutional revision and insisting on amending the constitution—while the public's livelihoods are burning, they gather and only talk about 'the party leader should step down' or 'with Jang Dong-hyuk, we'll lose the general election.' Will we win the election like that?" He added, "Rather than telling a second-term party leader (elected in a by-election) to step down, if senior lawmakers were to declare they won't run and say, 'Let's sacrifice so young talent can join the People Power Party and fight anew,' we could achieve far better results in the next general election." (장 대표는 이날 펜앤마이크티브이(TV) 유튜브에 출연해 “중진들이 희생해야 한다”고 날을 세웠다. 그는 최근 이재명 대통령과 골프 회동을 한 중진 의원들을 향해 “민주당과 맞서 싸워도 시원찮을 판에 연임 개헌을 꿈꾸는 대통령과 골프 치고 개헌해야 한다고 주장하는 모습들이나, 민생이 타들어 가고 있는데 모여서 ‘당대표 물러나야 한다’, ‘장동혁으로는 총선 진다’는 얘기만 하는데 총선을 이기겠나”라고 직격했다. 그러면서 “1.5선(보궐선거로 당선된 재선) 당대표에게 물러나라고 할 게 아니라 중진들이 불출마를 선언하고 ‘젊은 인재들이 국민의힘에 들어와서 새롭게 싸울 수 있도록 희생합시다’ 한마디 하면 다음 총선에서 훨씬 더 좋은 결과를 얻을 수 있을 것”이라고 했다.)

Among lawmakers, there is talk that the workshop scheduled for the 27th and 28th will serve as a barometer of Jang's grip on the party. A second-term lawmaker told the Hankyoreh, "At the workshop, lawmakers' level of support for Jang will inevitably show clearly through attendance rates and reactions," predicting, "That will be the moment when it's decided whether the party will center on Floor Leader Jung." (의원들 사이에서는 오는 27∼28일로 예정된 의원 연찬회가 장 대표의 당 장악력을 가늠하는 지표가 될 것이라는 이야기가 나온다. 한 재선 의원은 한겨레에 “연찬회에서 장 대표에 대한 의원들의 호응도가 참석률, 반응 등으로 명백하게 나타날 수밖에 없다”며 “이 자리에서 당이 정 원내대표 중심으로 가게 될지 결정될 것”이라고 내다봤다.)

Cho Hee-yeon, Reporter choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Government and ruling party call 'reduction of South Korea-US drills' an 'opportunity to improve inter-Korean relations,' opposition says 'South Korea being sidelined' (‘한미훈련 축소’에 정부·여당 “남북관계 개선 계기” 야당 “대한민국 패싱”)
item.description:
Regarding U.S. President Donald Trump's directive to reduce South Korea-U.S. joint military exercises, it has emerged that neither South Korea's foreign minister nor defense minister received prior notification from the United States. The government and the ruling party expressed expectations for the possibility of a North Korea-U.S. summit and the improvement of inter-Korean relations, while the opposition voiced concerns that this was an 'issue that could seriously affect national security.' (도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령의 한-미 연합훈련 축소 지시와 관련해 우리 외교·국방부 장관 모두 미국의 사전 통보를 받지 못한 것으로 나타났다. 정부와 여당은 북-미 정상회담 성사 가능성과 남북관계 개선에 대한 기대감을 보였지만, 야당은 ‘안보에 심각한 영향을 미칠 사안’이라고 우려를 보였다.)

Foreign Minister Cho Hyun said at a plenary session of the National Assembly's Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee held on the 19th, "The content that President Trump revealed (on his social media platform) Truth Social this time was not known in advance at all, not only to our government but also to officials of the U.S. government." Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek, who attended the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee that day, also said, "No one among South Korean and U.S. government authorities knew the content." (조현 외교부 장관은 19일 열린 국회 외교통일위원회 전체회의에서 “이번에 트럼프 대통령이 (사회관계망서비스인) 트루스소셜에 밝힌 내용은 우리 정부는 물론이고 미국 정부의 관계자들도 전혀 사전에 알지 못했다”고 말했다. 이날 국회 법제사법위원회에 출석한 안규백 국방부 장관도 “한·미 정부 당국자는 아무도 내용을 몰랐다”고 했다.)

On the 16th (local time), President Trump, while hinting at dialogue with North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un, ordered the reduction of the South Korea-U.S. joint exercise, the 'Ulchi Freedom Shield (UFS).' The Joint Chiefs of Staff announced that day that the exercise, originally scheduled to run from the 17th to the 27th, would be shortened and conducted until the 21st. (지난 16일(현지시각) 트럼프 대통령은 김정은 북한 국무위원장과의 대화를 시사하며 한-미 연합연습인 ‘을지 자유의 방패(UFS)’ 연습 축소를 지시했다. 합동참모본부는 이날 애초 17일부터 27일까지 예정된 훈련을 21일까지로 단축해 시행하기로 했다고 밝혔다.)

In response to the opposition's criticism that the reduction of the drills demonstrates a crack in the South Korea-U.S. alliance, Minister Cho said, "(Minister Ahn Kyu-baek) consulted (with the United States), so I do not consider it a unilateral notification (from the U.S.)," adding, "The South Korea-U.S. alliance remains robust, and we have been consulting closely at all levels." However, when asked whether the reduction of the drills was pressure related to delays in U.S. investment, Minister Cho said, "I think (that) was also one of the motives." (훈련 축소가 한-미 동맹 균열을 보여주는 것 아니냐는 야당의 지적에 조 장관은 “(안규백 장관이 미국과) 함께 협의했기 때문에 (미국의) 일방적 통보라고는 생각하지 않는다”며 “한-미 동맹은 굳건하고, 각층에서 긴밀하게 협의를 이어오고 있다”고 했다. 다만 훈련 축소가 대미투자 지연에 대한 압박 아니냐는 우려에 조 장관은 “(그것도) 하나의 동기가 됐다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

The government and the ruling party assessed the reduction of the drills as a measure to facilitate a North Korea-U.S. summit. Unification Minister Chung Dong-young said, "President Trump's directive to reduce South Korea-U.S. joint exercises stems from his deliberations concerning peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula, and we share sympathy with President Trump's decision." Minister Cho also called it "a shift to a new phase" and said, "The government has made thorough preparations to open a channel for dialogue with North Korea, and we intend to consult closely with the U.S. side so as not to miss this opportunity." (정부와 여당은 훈련 축소가 북-미 정상회담을 견인하기 위한 조처라고 평가했다. 정동영 통일부 장관은 “트럼프 대통령의 한-미 연합훈련 축소 지시는 한반도의 평화와 안정과 관련한 고심에서 나온 것으로서 트럼프 대통령의 결단에 대해서 공감하는 입장”이라고 말했다. 조 장관도 “새로운 국면의 전환”이라며 “정부는 북한과의 대화의 물꼬를 트기 위해 만반의 준비를 해왔고, 이번 기회를 놓치지 않기 위해서 미 측과 긴밀하게 협의를 해 나갈 생각”이라고 말했다.)

Woo Won-shik, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, expressed expectations, saying, "To continue the nation's aspiration for peace on the Korean Peninsula, there is a peculiarity that North Korea-U.S. relations must be resolved to generate a wave of peace there, which is necessary for inter-Korean relations to progress as well," and added, "This could serve as a good opportunity to advance inter-Korean relations." (우원식 더불어민주당 의원은 “한반도 평화라는 민족의 염원을 이어가려면 북-미 관계가 해소돼 거기서 평화의 물결이 생겨나야 남북관계도 이뤄진다는 특수성이 있다”면서 “남북관계를 풀어가는 좋은 계기가 될 수 있다”고 기대감을 보였다.)

However, the opposition criticized the government's 'failure in diplomacy and security policy,' saying, "One cannot help but worry about whether our security will be properly maintained" (Kim Gun, People Power Party lawmaker). Kim Gun stated, "This exercise was important for gauging how to operate South Korea-U.S. combined forces, given that North Korean troops have learned new technologies for modern warfare through their deployment to Ukraine, yet it was suddenly reduced," and added, "It could seriously affect our security." Ko Dong-jin, also of the People Power Party, said, "There is widespread concern that the diplomatic posture involving South Korea, the United States, and North Korea is proceeding while excluding South Korea," and "It feels as if South Korea has been sidelined." (그러나 야당은 “안보가 제대로 지켜질지 걱정될 수밖에 없다”(김건 국민의힘 의원)며 정부의 ‘외교·안보 정책 실패’라고 비판했다. 김건 국민의힘 의원은 “이번 훈련은 북한군의 우크라이나 파병으로 현대전에 대한 새로운 기술을 익혔고, 그런걸 감안해 한·미 연합전력을 어떻게 운용할지 (가늠하는) 중요한 훈련이었는데, 갑자기 축소됐다”며 “우리 안보에 심각한 영향을 미칠 수 있다”고 했다. 고동진 국민의힘 의원도 “한국, 미국, 북한의 외교 모양새가 대한민국을 배제한 채 흘러가는 것 아닌가 하는 많은 우려가 있다”며 “대한민국이 패싱 당한 게 아닌가 하는 느낌”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "Cho Hee-dae, Worst Chief Justice Since Liberation" ... Demands Immediate Resignation (김민석 “조희대, 해방 이후 최악 대법원장”…즉각 사퇴 요구)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, on the 19th demanded the immediate resignation of Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae, who nominated Supreme Court justice candidates by written submission without prior coordination with the presidential office, calling him "the worst chief justice since liberation." Within the party, arguments for impeaching Chief Justice Cho also emerged. (김민석 더불어민주당 대표가 19일 청와대와 조율 없이 서면으로 대법관 후보 임명을 제청한 조희대 대법원장을 향해 “해방 이후 최악의 대법원장”이라며 즉각 사퇴를 요구했다. 당 안에서는 조 대법원장 탄핵 주장도 나왔다.)

At a Supreme Council meeting held on-site at the party's Busan branch in Dong-gu, Busan, Kim said, "Nominating Supreme Court justice candidates has customarily been done by the chief justice in consultation with the president, and committing this 'lawless' judicial act without doing so constitutes a 'judicial power grab.'" He added, "Chief Justice Cho's behavior is like a delinquent student begging to be expelled." On the 18th, Cho nominated Son Bong-ki, a presiding judge at the Daegu District Court (Judicial Research and Training Institute Class 22), and Kim Sung-soo, a presiding judge at the Seoul High Court (Class 24), as successors to former Justice Noh Tae-ak and Justice Lee Heung-gu, submitting the nomination to President Lee Jae-myung in writing, breaking the convention of prior consultation with the presidential office. (김 대표는 이날 부산 동구 민주당 부산시당에서 열린 현장 최고위원회의에서 “대법관 후보 임명제청은 관습법적으로 (대법원장이) 대통령과 협의해 제청해온 것인데 이걸 하지 않는 ‘무법’ 사법행위를 한 것은 ‘사법농단’”이라며 “조 대법원장의 행태는 퇴학시켜달라고 구걸하는 불량 학생의 태도”라고 말했다. 조 대법원장은 지난 18일 노태악 전 대법관과 이흥구 대법관 후임으로 손봉기 대구지법 부장판사(사법연수원 22기)와 김성수 서울고법 부장판사(24기)를 이재명 대통령에게 임명제청했으나, 이 과정에서 청와대와 사전 조율하는 관례를 깨고 ‘서면 제청’을 했다.)

Referring to the incident as the "Cho Hee-dae affair," Kim said, "We will use this as an opportunity to begin judicial reform," and added, "Cho Hee-dae, come to your senses and step down immediately. If not, apologize." (이번 사건을 “조희대 사태”라고 표현한 김 대표는 “이를 계기로 사법 개혁을 시작하겠다”며 “조희대씨는 정신 차리고 당장 나가라. 아니면 사과하라”고 말했다.)

At the same meeting, senior Supreme Council member Choi Min-hee said, "Chief Justice Cho and the judiciary must face the people's hammer," and "The National Assembly should immediately begin discussions on Cho Hee-dae's fate, including impeachment." However, Rep. Kim Seung-won, the ruling party's secretary on the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, distanced himself from immediate impeachment proceedings, saying, "First, we need to establish the facts." (최민희 수석최고위원은 같은 회의에서 “조 대법원장과 사법부는 국민의 철퇴를 맞아야 한다”며 “국회가 즉시 탄핵을 포함한 조희대 거취 논의를 시작해야 한다”고 말했다. 다만 국회 법제사법위원회 여당 간사인 김승원 의원은 “사실관계 파악 우선”이라고 즉각적 탄핵 추진에는 거리를 뒀다.)

In response, People Power Party senior spokesperson Park Choong-kwon commented, "This is a blatant attempt to tame the judiciary and an arrogant rampage aimed at neutralizing the chief justice's lawful authority over personnel nominations." (이에 대해 박충권 국민의힘 수석대변인은 “대법원장의 적법한 인사 제청권마저 무력화하려는 노골적인 사법부 길들이기자 오만한 폭주”라고 논평했다.)

Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr, Busan/Reporter Ko Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr, 부산/고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Min-seok Says "There Are No Factions" at First Open Supreme Council Meeting... Courting the Core Support Base (김민석, 첫 공개 최고위에서 “계파는 없다”…핵심 지지층 끌어안기)
item.description:
<<>> New Democratic Party of Korea leader Kim Min-seok held his first open Supreme Council meeting in Busan on the 19th and emphasized a party unity stance, declaring "there are no factions." He also continued efforts to embrace the traditional support base by visiting former presidents who came from the Democratic Party. <<> At the Supreme Council meeting held at the Busan city party headquarters in Dong-gu, Busan, Kim said, "I will handle appointments transparently and on the basis of merit. I will pursue unity with a focus on work. We will build harmony step by step through our work." He added, "The people-first and pragmatic expansion platform I advocated during this party convention received overwhelming support from party members and delegates," and "I will lead the party to close the gap between the party's sentiment and the public's sentiment." <<> Kim also said, "I will conduct the Supreme Council meetings with logic that the public and party members can understand and with dignified language they can accept," adding, "The Supreme Council meetings will, in principle, be open, and confidential matters will be strictly observed. If confidential matters are leaked, the person responsible will be expelled from the meeting regardless of rank." This is seen as an intention to preemptively prevent the internal party conflicts that erupted during the party convention from being aired through open and closed Supreme Council meetings. The current Supreme Council includes lawmakers Choi Min-hee, Lee Sung-yoon, and Han Min-soo, who are considered pro-Chung (pro-Chung Cheong-rae) figures. Kim also announced that he would spend at least two to three days a week on regional schedules. <<> Ahead of the Supreme Council meeting, Kim met with Busan Mayor Jeon Jae-soo to emphasize his commitment to regional development, and after the meeting, he visited Bongha Village in Gimhae, South Gyeongsang Province, to pay respects at the grave of former President Roh Moo-hyun and call on former First Lady Kwon Yang-sook. In the guestbook at Roh's grave, Kim wrote, "I will open wide the path of popular sovereignty that you walked yourself, as a model for the world." He then visited Pyeongsan Village in Yangsan, South Gyeongsang Province, to call on former President Moon Jae-in. According to Senior Spokesperson Park Sung-joon, Moon told Kim at the meeting, "With the fierce competition during the party convention, it seems party members have suffered deep internal wounds," and urged efforts toward tolerance and unity. In response, Kim said, "I will do my full part within the party, including campaigns, to ensure that ridicule, hateful contempt, and abusive language do not run rampant." Park explained Kim's schedule as "a display of commitment to unity, inclusion, and people's livelihoods." The Busan and South Gyeongsang regions visited that day are known to have many party members with strong pro-Roh and pro-Moon leanings. <<> Kim also accelerated the formation of the leadership by announcing additional key party appointments that day. Rep. Moon Jin-seok (second term, Cheonan Gap, South Chungcheong) was named Senior Deputy Secretary-General for Administration, and Rep. Ahn Tae-joon (first term, Gwangju Eul, Gyeonggi) was appointed Deputy Secretary-General for Organization. In addition, an "Innovation Task Force (TF)" was launched to reform the Democratic Party Research Institute, the party's think tank, with Rep. Kang Deuk-gu (second term, Anyang Manan, Gyeonggi) named as its head. All of these figures are classified as pro-Lee (pro-Lee Jae-myung) members. <<> On the evening of the same day, Kim visited the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae at the invitation of President Lee Jae-myung to have dinner with fellow leadership candidates Chung Cheong-rae and Song Young-gil, who had competed against him in the party leadership race. On the 20th, he is scheduled to visit former Prime Minister Lee Hae-chan and pay respects at the grave of former National Assembly Speaker Kim Keun-tae. <<> Reporter Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Busan·Gimhae·Yangsan / Reporter Ko Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr ()
